heard: Joktan fathered Almudad, Shalef came next in the line As Armaveth and Jerah in the east they drew near Sons of Shem after the flood, descendants of Noah's blood A family tree from the start in the land of these parts Thirteen suns in the list of Jobton's lineage distinct In the mountain regions high under the open sky Genesis records their names, Chronicles repeats the same From the beginning of days to the light of our eyes Part of the nation spread
